name: The Hawk
description: On the back nine of his career, golf legend Lonnie "The Hawk" Hawkins chases one final major — and drags everyone he loves into the chaos.

videos.title: The Hawk
videos.overview: After experiencing a tragedy on the course, past-his-prime golfer Lonnie Hawkins decides to make one last stand to achieve his career Grand Slam.

videos.title: The Family That Plays Together
videos.overview: As the golf world gathers for a tearful farewell, Lonnie infuriates Lance and Stacy by choosing the fairway over the funeral home.

videos.title: Roses & Thorns
videos.overview: When Lonnie's game begins to waver, Sam helps him reconnect with his roots. Natalie tries to overcome Stacy's smothering presence on the green.

videos.title: Tears of a Hero
videos.overview: Lonnie's triumphant return to the PGA Tour is dampened by a Danish rival. Lance and Natalie host an engagement party to remember.

videos.title: The Prison Yard
videos.overview: Lonnie lands a magazine cover that leaves his entire circle seething. Sam's past finally catches up with her.

videos.title: The Genesis Invitational
videos.overview: Lonnie, Lance and Golden sow chaos on the course when they're paired for a tournament round. An unwelcome discovery pushes Natalie to her limit.

videos.title: Vegas
videos.overview: With $3 million on the line, father and son go head-to-head in a simulation golf tournament in Vegas — and all bets are off.

videos.title: The Code
videos.overview: In the messy aftermath of the Vegas trip, Lonnie tries to win back Sam's trust, Stacy has complicated feelings and Lance hits rock bottom.

videos.title: Pebble
videos.overview: Lonnie revisits the scene of his worst defeat. Stacy and Golden get down to business. Lance gains an enhanced perspective on his daddy issues.

videos.title: Pickle
videos.overview: Lonnie, Lance and Golden compete for championship glory at the U.S. Open — where the trophy isn't the only thing being chased.
